name: ShopLakehouse · Daily merchandise revenue
description: Delivered orders valued at their historical sale prices.

name: ShopLakehouse · Sales KPIs
description: Delivered merchandise revenue, orders, and weighted average order value.

name: ShopLakehouse · Top products
description: Top ten products by delivered merchandise revenue.

name: ShopLakehouse · Category sales
description: Delivered order items grouped by product category.

name: ShopLakehouse · Cash and refunds
description: Net successful cash movement and refunds by processing date; distinct from merchandise revenue.

name: ShopLakehouse · Customer historical value
description: Observed delivered spend; this is not a predictive lifetime value.

name: ShopLakehouse · Cohort retention
description: Monthly active buyers divided by original cohort buyers.

name: ShopLakehouse · Marketing performance
description: Traffic and ad metrics by channel; no unmeasured attribution or ROI is claimed.

name: ShopLakehouse · Repeat customers
description: Share of observed buyers with at least two delivered orders.

name: ShopLakehouse · Cancellation trend
description: Cancelled orders divided by all orders by placement date.

name: ShopLakehouse · Payment methods
description: Successful charges and refunds by payment method.

name: ShopLakehouse · Customer cities
description: Delivered revenue by observed historical city; unknown captures pre-observation orders.

name: ShopLakehouse · Monthly revenue growth
description: Month over month delivered revenue growth, using a window function.

name: ShopLakehouse · Basket size
description: Average units and distinct products in delivered orders.

name: ShopLakehouse · Discounts by category
description: Discounts are per line, not per unit.

name: ShopLakehouse · Running revenue
description: Cumulative delivered revenue over calendar dates.

name: ShopLakehouse · Top products per category
description: Top three products in each category by delivered revenue.

name: ShopLakehouse · RFM segmentation
description: Recency relative to latest observed order date, frequency and monetary quartiles.

name: ShopLakehouse · AOV trend
description: Daily delivered merchandise revenue per delivered order.

name: ShopLakehouse · Traffic funnel
description: Channel funnel totals; simulated aggregate feeds are not user-level attribution.

name: ShopLakehouse · Basket product pairs
description: Co-purchased product pairs in delivered orders.

name: ShopLakehouse · Customer revenue Pareto
description: Cumulative observed spend share by customer rank.

name: ShopLakehouse · Year over year
description: Monthly same-month prior-year comparison; null where history is absent.

name: ShopLakehouse · Seven-day revenue average
description: Calendar-day average including zero-revenue dates.
